lines.beaver_en: Come in. What seems to be the problem?
lines.en: Since yesterday I've had a bad stomachache and threw up.
I ate raw fish, and I think I have indigestion.
I feel dizzy and I'm very thirsty.
No fever. It's not the flu, right?

lines.beaver_en: Right. From your symptoms, it looks like food poisoning.
lines.en: Can I get tested for food poisoning too?

lines.beaver_en: Yes. Do you have any allergies?
lines.en: Yes, when I eat shrimp, my body gets itchy.

lines.learner: 변비는 없어요. 그런데 팔에 멍이 있어요.
lines.en: No constipation. But I have a bruise on my arm.
lines.roman: byeonbineun eopseoyo. geureonde pare meongi isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How did you get the bruise?
lines.en: I fell last week and sprained my ankle too.

lines.beaver_en: Is there anything else worrying you?
lines.en: I'm worried it might be cancer.

lines.beaver: 암은 아니에요. 약은 하루 세 번씩 드세요.
lines.beaver_en: It's not cancer. Take the medicine three times a day.
lines.beaver_roman: ameun anieyo. yageun haru se beonssik deuseyo.
